summary: Maps a collision shape identifier (one of 1-12, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 50) to a bone index (153-189) by subtracting a boolean flag from a shape-specific base value. On success writes the bone index to output this+0x8 and the result of sub_414180(0) to this+0xC, then returns 1. Returns -1 when a2 is non-zero, when the shape identifier is unrecognized, or when the computed index is negative.

operations.description: Initialize result to -1 as the default failure value.
When a2 is non-zero, skip mapping and return the default -1.
Dispatch on shape identifier a3 via the jump table jpt_412C54 and case table byte_412E18; for each recognized case compute v5 = base - (a4 != 0), with bases 189 down to 153 for shapes 1 through 50.
Proceed to the write only when the computed bone index v5 is >= 0.
Write the mapped bone index v5 to the output dword at this+0x8.
Write the result of sub_414180(0) to the output dword at this+0xC.
Set result to 1 after a successful mapping.
Return 1 on success, or -1 when a2 is non-zero or the shape identifier is unrecognized.
